## Pull Request Checklist

Please ensure that you have completed the following steps before submitting your Pull Request:
- [ ] Checked that there aren't other open Pull Requests for the same update/change.
- [ ] Linked the associated issue (if applicable).
- [ ] Added tests that prove your fix is effective or that your feature works.
- [ ] Ensured that all tests pass locally (`npm run test:backend` & `npm run test:frontend`).
- [ ] Updated the documentation accordingly.

## Description of Changes
<!-- Please provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does. -->

## Related Issue(s)
<!-- Fixes #123 -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update
